On the back, in her own handwriting, were two words: Thank you.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯沿着空街铺开淡黄的光，清洁车缓缓驶过，刷子卷起昨夜的落叶。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃升起。远处有货车低鸣，近处的猫跃上围墙。有人刚刚下班，有人已经出门；更多的人还在梦里，等天色替他们翻开新的一页。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no smaller box inside."}
